integrity: Analytic proof supplied with assumptions and boundary handling; finite checker corroborates but does not certify universal claims. No independent mathematical audit or authorship/provenance beyond the attached source citations is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The formula assumes one independent uniform-arclength sample from each triangle side. It does not treat perimeter-pooled samples, non-triangles, or correlated samples. The entropy expansion is along a fixed interior direction; no uniform endpoint claim. Literature comparison cannot rule out unindexed earlier elementary derivations.
title: Exact barycentric inclusion depth for side-stratified random triangles
